# Paw & Prosper -- Full Content Reference

## About

Paw & Prosper is a digital marketing consultancy specializing in SEO and AI visibility systems for animal wellness businesses. Founded by Samantha Quinones, the company works exclusively with veterinarians, pet brands, animal shelters, animal rescues, groomers, trainers, boarding/daycare facilities, and other pet service businesses.

The company's core belief: the animal wellness industry deserves specialized marketing expertise, not generic agency work. Pet parents now search across both traditional search engines and AI assistants, and businesses that aren't visible in both places are missing clients.

Samantha Quinones is a digital marketer with over 12 years of experience in SEO and AI search optimization. She created Paw & Prosper after seeing how many high-quality animal wellness businesses were invisible online -- not because their work wasn't excellent, but because they lacked the right visibility strategy. Outside of work, she's a dog mom to Itachi, a Lab-Collie mix, and volunteers at her local animal shelter.

Paw & Prosper offers nonprofit pricing to animal shelters, rescues, and animal welfare nonprofits. Reduced monthly rates, free workshops on Google and AI visibility, bonus audits, and case study collaborations.

Contact: samantha@pawandprosper.com

## Core Services

### Local SEO Optimization
Helps pet businesses rank higher in Google and local search results. Includes keyword strategy, Google Business Profile optimization, local citation building, on-page SEO, and technical SEO.

### AI Visibility & LLM Optimization
Optimizes business content so AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) accurately represent and recommend the business. Includes structured data implementation, content formatting for AI ingestion, and AI citation monitoring.

### Content Strategy & Authority Building
Builds topical authority through SEO-optimized blog content, service page optimization, and educational resources that rank in search and get cited by AI tools.

## Who We Serve

- Independent Veterinary Clinics: Independent and specialty vet practices competing with corporate chains (Banfield, VCA, BluePearl, National Veterinary Associates). Corporate groups have national ad budgets and dedicated SEO teams. Paw & Prosper helps independent practices compete on strategy, community trust, and organic visibility. Focus on local search, emergency and specialty search terms, and AI recommendations for pet health questions.
- Animal Shelters: Public and nonprofit shelters seeking more adoptions, donations, and volunteers through improved search presence and community visibility. Both municipal animal control facilities and 501(c)(3) nonprofits. Includes Google Business Profile optimization, review strategy, and local search visibility.
- Animal Rescues: Foster-based and breed-specific rescue organizations. Rescues face unique SEO challenges: no physical storefront, geographically dispersed foster networks, and the need to reach adopters, fosters, and donors simultaneously. Breed-specific rescues have strong long-tail keyword advantages. Paw & Prosper builds visibility strategies designed for how rescues actually operate.
- Pet Brands: E-commerce and DTC pet product companies (food, supplements, accessories, gear) wanting organic traffic and AI-powered product discovery. Focus on product page SEO, category optimization, brand authority, and reducing paid ad dependence.
- Pet Services: Groomers, trainers, boarding/daycare facilities, holistic pet wellness practitioners, and other local pet service businesses. Focus on local search, Google Maps visibility, and AI assistant recommendations.

## Case Studies

### Lone Star Animal Welfare League: 32x Google Visibility Growth in Six Months
LSAWL is a shelter and rescue nonprofit serving the Bryan-College Station, Texas area. Starting from near-zero online visibility with no paid advertising budget, LSAWL worked with Paw & Prosper on local SEO and AI visibility optimization. Result: 32x growth in Google search visibility in six months, with no paid ad spend. Full case study: https://pawandprosper.com/how-lone-star-animal-welfare-league-grew-google-visibility-32x-in-six-months-no-ad-spend

### How AI Is Changing the Way Pet Owners Find Veterinary Care
URL: https://pawandprosper.com/blog/how-ai-is-changing-the-way-pet-owners-find-veterinary-care
Published: September 25, 2026
Author: Samantha Quinones, Founder & SEO Strategist at Paw & Prosper
Summary: Explores the shift from traditional search to AI-powered discovery for pet owners seeking veterinary care. Covers what Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, and Perplexity are doing to traditional search behavior, how veterinary practices can optimize for AI recommendations, and the three practical levers that move the needle: Google Business Profile optimization, trust-building content, and structured data. Argues that practices not showing up in AI answers are already losing patients to competitors who are.

Targeted at independent veterinary practice owners and managers.

## The Problem We Solve

Pet parents now use multiple search surfaces to find pet services and products:
1. Traditional Google Search ("vet near me", "best grain-free dog food")
2. Google Maps and local pack results
3. AI assistants ("which vet in my area is best for anxious dogs?", "recommend a natural supplement for senior cats")

Most animal wellness businesses are optimized for none of these, or at best one. Paw & Prosper builds visibility systems that work across all three.

## Our Process

1. Free Visibility Audit: Analyze the business's current presence across Google, AI assistants, and local directories.
2. Custom Insights Report: Detailed breakdown of visibility gaps, quick wins, and long-term opportunities.
3. Strategy Call: Walk through findings and discuss a tailored plan.
4. Ongoing Optimization: Monthly work that compounds visibility over time.

## Key Differentiators

- Exclusively serves the animal wellness industry
- Combines traditional SEO with AI visibility optimization (most agencies do one or the other)
- Independent business working with independent businesses -- no national agency account handoffs
- Nonprofit pricing for animal shelters, rescues, and animal welfare organizations
- Founder has 12+ years of digital marketing experience and personally volunteers in animal welfare
- Focuses on long-term organic visibility, not just paid traffic
